uart.signal: the committed RV32IMAC fixture ELF (examples/ch32v203c8t6/uart_hello.c) clocks USART1 from APB2PCENR bit 14, maps TX to PA9 through GPIOA_CFGHR, checks a MUL/DIVU/AMOADD.W result and writes 'Hello from CH32V203\r\n' through DATAR (0x40013804); the test asserts the console sink receives exactly that string, and a negative control with the clock gate moved to an unset bit asserts the sink stays empty. Polled TX only: no PFIC, so USART1_IRQn is not wired
uart.lane: pr-workspace-tests shards - cargo test -p labwired-core --test vendor ch32_compiled_firmware::

spi.gap: SPI1 (0x40013000) and SPI2 are not modelled; they are not in the ch32v203c8t6 descriptor's peripherals list.
